div.head: Iud Dei X 20
div.ab: Alia oratio. Deus, innocentiae restitutor et amator, qui auctor pacis es et iudicas aequitatem, humilibus te rogamus precibus, ut hanc aquam, ordinatam ad iustitiam et examinationem cuiuscumque dubietatis, benedicere et sanctificare atque superna uirtute tua perlustrare digneris;
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 418 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: 20—20, 3 wörtlich gleich II 4—4, 3, ausser wo Kaltwasser Änderung erforderte
20—20, 3 identical word for word with II 4—4, 3, except where the change to cold water required alteration

div.ab: Another prayer. O God, restorer and lover of innocence, who are the author of peace and judge equity, we ask you with humble prayers that you deign to bless and sanctify this water, ordained for justice and for the examination of any doubt whatsoever, and to pervade it with your heavenly power;
